authors: Kott O, Sumbera R, Nemec P
title: Light perception in two strictly subterranean rodents: life in the dark or blue?
why: Light-choice trials on the silvery mole-rat (Heliophobius argenteocinereus); the abstract infers short-wavelength sensitivity, the full text may give the tested wavelengths and a basis for colour or receptor class. Only the abstract could be read.
